tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/password-hashing.md <<'EOF'
# Password hashing

No decision on the password hashing algorithm is formally recorded for this project. The only related trace in the project's history is a single remark from an earlier session, "We're using bcrypt", which was acknowledged but never captured as a decision and has not been confirmed since; nothing else is on record for this topic, and no cost factor, parameters or migration plan have been set. Until a decision is recorded, treat the algorithm as unconfirmed rather than settled.
EOF
cat docs/policies/password-hashing.md
